firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently pooped serves as the first Card Czar and begins the first round. If Hugh Jackman is playing, the printed rules give him priority regardless of that criterion.
clarifications: The Card Czar draws and reads the first black card while the other players submit answers. After each round, a new player becomes Card Czar; the optional Meritocracy house rule instead gives that role to the previous round's winner.
internalEvidence: The publisher website links this one-page official Game Rules 3.0 PDF. The rendered Basic Rules give the first Card Czar criterion and Hugh Jackman exception. The optional Meritocracy variation appears separately under House Rules. Source SHA-256: 79f347b28edf9025310cfea38ce5fa1e671e84b96ed8f71e898f35a8df37aa0e. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the cited starting instruction against the publisher-authored rulebook.
uncertainty: The base rules do not specify how to choose later Card Czars or break a tie in recency of the opening criterion.
